card.name: Contraindication lists in drug labels
card.fires_on: Positions inside the Contraindications section of a drug label, such as within a drug name or a cross-reference after a listed condition like hypersensitivity, obstruction or bleeding. It fires on small pieces like a comma, space, or part of a name.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a drug or brand name that follows 'hypersensitivity to' in a contraindication.
modes.example: Use in patients with known hypersensitivity to pioglitazone, glimepiride or any other component of pi<<og>>litazone and glimepiride

modes.label: Punctuation and cross-references
modes.description: Commas, spaces or section-reference pieces right after a contraindicated condition.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Gastrointestinal (GI) obstruction<<,>> ileus, or gastric retention (

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated odd pieces and the suppressed ones are Chinese words for 'not allowed', so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up while the model is reading a label's list of conditions in which the drug must not be used.
